question: What is the minimum clear distance between side rails for all portable ladders?
source_quote: The minimum clear distance between side rails for all portable ladders must be 11.5 inches (29 cm).

question: How far above the top landing do the side rails of a portable ladder have to stick out?
source_quote: the side rails must extend at least 3 feet (.9 m) above the upper landing surface.

question: At what angle from the horizontal must stairways be installed?
expected_answer: At least 30 degrees and no more than 50 degrees from the horizontal.
source_quote: Stairways must be installed at least 30 degrees —and no more than 50 degrees—from the horizontal.

question: On stairways that will not be a permanent part of the building, how big must the landings be and how often are they needed?
expected_answer: At least 30 inches deep and 22 inches wide (76 x 56 cm) at every 12 feet (3.7 m) or less of vertical rise.
source_quote: landings at least 30 inches deep and 22 inches wide (76 x 56 cm) at every 12 feet (3.7 m) or less of vertical rise.

question: What weight must handrails and top rails of stair rail systems be able to withstand?
expected_answer: At least 200 pounds (890 n) of weight applied within 2 inches (5 cm) of the top edge, in any downward or outward direction.
source_quote: must be able to withstand, without failure, at least 200 pounds (890 n) of weight applied within 2 inches (5 cm) of the top edge in any downward or outward direction
